changeSet.comment: nexus.rdr229_restamp(p_table text) RETURNS text, the operator's way back from an orphan (RDR-229 P3.1 fix round A, critique S1 / code review F4). A stamp move whose on_complete found an orphan row (a name with no registry row in its tenant) COMPLETES and leaves the table's CHECK NOT VALID; it does not run again, so registering the missing collection stamped nothing and the VALIDATE kept raising 23514. SELECT nexus.rdr229_restamp('chunk_orphaned_at') registers the table's stamp move again: a new data_moves row (a label is the primary key) named rdr229-stamp-<table>-rerun-N that supersedes the previous move of the chain (the completed original, or the last re-run) and copies its template, verification, on_complete, throttle and changeset_id, so the worker stamps the rows that have become resolvable and validates the CHECK(s). It registers only when the chain's last move is complete, a CHECK of the table is NOT VALID and no orphan row remains (an orphan being a row that names a collection no registry row of its tenant carries); otherwise it says why, as text, and raises nothing and writes nothing. The list of tables, name columns, id columns and constraints is a copy of db/rdr229/p31-checks.tsv (the one list), pinned equal by Rdr229RestampFunctionIntegrationTest. SECURITY INVOKER and EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC: nexus.data_moves is the migrating role's, nexus_svc holds no grant on it. It reads the registry and the table to look for an orphan (a bounded scan of the rows with a NULL id, as the on_complete guard does) and writes one row to nexus.data_moves; no row of a user-data table changes. DATA EFFECT: none at boot; the function is created, not called. The rollback drops it.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.rdr229_restamp(p_table text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog, nexus AS $f$ DECLARE v_base text := 'rdr229-stamp-' || p_table; v_n integer; v_tail text; v_done timestamptz; v_orphan boolean; r record; BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.data_moves m WHERE m.label = v_base) THEN RETURN 'not registered: ' || v_base || ' is not a registered stamp move'; END IF; SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM nexus.data_moves m WHERE starts_with(m.label, v_base || '-rerun-'); v_tail := CASE WHEN v_n = 0 THEN v_base ELSE v_base || '-rerun-' || v_n END; SELECT m.completed_at INTO v_done FROM nexus.data_moves m WHERE m.label = v_tail; IF v_done IS NULL THEN RETURN 'not registered: ' || v_tail || ' has not completed (it is open, paused or failed); nx doctor says which'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint k JOIN (VALUES ('catalog_collections', 'superseded_by', 'superseded_by_id', 'catalog_collections_superseded_by_id_check', 'SUPERSEDED'), ('chunks', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'chunks_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('chunks', '-', 'collection_id', 'chunks_collection_id_not_null', 'NOT_NULL'), ('taxonomy_centroids', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'taxonomy_centroids_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('taxonomy_centroids', '-', 'collection_id', 'taxonomy_centroids_collection_id_not_null', 'NOT_NULL'), ('catalog_document_chunks', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'catalog_document_chunks_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('chunk_orphaned_at', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'chunk_orphaned_at_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('topic_assignments', 'source_collection', 'source_collection_id', 'topic_assignments_source_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('document_aspects', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'document_aspects_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('topics', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'topics_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('taxonomy_meta', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'taxonomy_meta_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('document_highlights', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'document_highlights_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('canary_query_ring', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'canary_query_ring_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('aspect_extraction_queue', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'aspect_extraction_queue_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('catalog_documents', 'physical_collection', 'physical_collection_id', 'catalog_documents_physical_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('chash_remap', 'source_collection', 'source_collection_id', 'chash_remap_source_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('chash_remap', 'target_collection', 'target_collection_id', 'chash_remap_target_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('pdf_pipeline', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'pdf_pipeline_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('reembed_jobs', 'source_collection', 'source_collection_id', 'reembed_jobs_source_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('reembed_jobs', 'target_collection', 'target_collection_id', 'reembed_jobs_target_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID') ) AS t(tbl, name_column, id_column, conname, kind) ON t.conname = k.conname WHERE t.tbl = p_table AND k.conrelid = to_regclass('nexus.' || quote_ident(p_table)) AND NOT k.convalidated) THEN RETURN 'not registered: no CHECK of ' || p_table || ' is NOT VALID (or the table has none), so there is nothing to finish'; END IF; FOR r IN SELECT DISTINCT t.name_column, t.id_column FROM (VALUES ('catalog_collections', 'superseded_by', 'superseded_by_id', 'catalog_collections_superseded_by_id_check', 'SUPERSEDED'), ('chunks', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'chunks_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('chunks', '-', 'collection_id', 'chunks_collection_id_not_null', 'NOT_NULL'), ('taxonomy_centroids', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'taxonomy_centroids_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('taxonomy_centroids', '-', 'collection_id', 'taxonomy_centroids_collection_id_not_null', 'NOT_NULL'), ('catalog_document_chunks', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'catalog_document_chunks_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('chunk_orphaned_at', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'chunk_orphaned_at_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('topic_assignments', 'source_collection', 'source_collection_id', 'topic_assignments_source_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('document_aspects', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'document_aspects_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('topics', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'topics_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('taxonomy_meta', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'taxonomy_meta_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('document_highlights', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'document_highlights_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('canary_query_ring', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'canary_query_ring_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('aspect_extraction_queue', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'aspect_extraction_queue_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('catalog_documents', 'physical_collection', 'physical_collection_id', 'catalog_documents_physical_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('chash_remap', 'source_collection', 'source_collection_id', 'chash_remap_source_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('chash_remap', 'target_collection', 'target_collection_id', 'chash_remap_target_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('pdf_pipeline', 'collection', 'collection_id', 'pdf_pipeline_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('reembed_jobs', 'source_collection', 'source_collection_id', 'reembed_jobs_source_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID'), ('reembed_jobs', 'target_collection', 'target_collection_id', 'reembed_jobs_target_collection_id_check', 'NAME_ID') ) AS t(tbl, name_column, id_column, conname, kind) WHERE t.tbl = p_table AND t.kind = 'NAME_ID' LOOP EXECUTE format('SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.%1$I t WHERE NULLIF(t.%2$I, '''') IS NOT NULL AND t.%3$I IS NULL ' 'AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_collections cc WHERE cc.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND cc.name = t.%2$I))', p_table, r.name_column, r.id_column) INTO v_orphan; IF v_orphan THEN RETURN 'not registered: ' || p_table || ' still has an orphan row (a ' || r.name_column || ' that names no registry row of its tenant); ' || 'register that collection or delete the row, then run this again'; END IF; END LOOP; INSERT INTO nexus.data_moves (label, template, driving_schema, driving_table, chunk_size, sleep_ms, statement_timeout_ms, verification, on_complete, changeset_id, supersedes) SELECT v_base || '-rerun-' || (v_n + 1), b.template, b.driving_schema, b.driving_table, b.chunk_size, b.sleep_ms, b.statement_timeout_ms, b.verification, b.on_complete, b.changeset_id, v_tail FROM nexus.data_moves b WHERE b.label = v_base; RETURN 'registered: ' || v_base || '-rerun-' || (v_n + 1); END $f$; REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION nexus.rdr229_restamp(text) FROM PUBLIC;
